nodes.name: .env.example
nodes.summary: Environment variable template with 21 placeholder definitions covering Supabase credentials, Meta WhatsApp API, Razorpay payments, worker configuration, and rate limiting.
nodes.languageNotes: Defines 21 environment variables including SUPABASE_URL, META_*, RAZORPAY_*, CRON_SECRET, WORKER_SECRET, ENABLE_WORKER_TRIGGER, and rate limit settings.

nodes.name: AGENTS.md
nodes.summary: Agent operating contract identical to CLAUDE.md — defines identity, stack authority, context discipline, security posture, correctness invariants, testing standards, and governance rules for Claude Code sessions.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURAL_DRIFT_REGISTER.md
nodes.summary: Tracks deviations between the declared architecture and actual implementation, cataloging drift by severity (P0-P3), class, and root cause across all phases.

nodes.name: ARCHITECTURE.md
nodes.summary: System architecture reference covering technology stack (Supabase, PostgreSQL, Deno, TypeScript), multi-tenant security model, 10 core engines (booking, queue, payment, WhatsApp, SLA, monitoring, audit, worker, analytics), and the enterprise intelligence layer.

nodes.name: AUDIT_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 0 comprehensive audit covering module completion (16/16 shared modules, 21/21 edge functions, 37/37 migrations), technical debt assessment, system architecture, feature inventory, and development roadmap.

nodes.name: CERTIFICATION_RECONCILIATION.md
nodes.summary: Reconciled certification dispositions across all phases (0 through 1.5), systematically evaluating each phase's claims against evidence with method rules, claim-by-claim verdicts, and consolidated certification outcomes.

nodes.name: CLAUDE.md
nodes.summary: Primary Claude Code operating contract defining SETURA's identity as a production-grade multi-tenant hospital SaaS, establishing stack authority (Deno, Supabase, PostgreSQL), source-of-truth hierarchy, architecture rules, security invariants, testing standard, and governance discipline across 18 numbered sections.

nodes.name: CROSS_CHECK_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Product description versus actual codebase cross-verification — confirms 6 core features match implementation, identifies 4 areas where the description overstates reality (backend completeness, dashboards, WhatsApp-first positioning), and notes undersold capabilities.

nodes.name: CROSS_PHASE_AUDIT_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Comprehensive cross-phase architecture, requirements, and gap reconciliation audit across phases 0 through 1.5+ with 24 numbered parts covering architecture verification, phase-by-phase contract reconciliation, 6 end-to-end workflow analyses, database/RPC inventory, edge function reconciliation, worker/cron analysis, fresh security review, financial integrity, KPI tracing, test quality audit, migration history, drift analysis, and 14-question final architecture verdict.

nodes.name: CROSS_PHASE_GAP_REGISTER.md
nodes.summary: Consolidated gap register across all phases cataloging 4 P0 production blockers, 13 P1 deploy-blocking issues, 15 P2 survivable issues, 10 P3 hygiene items, and 6 NPDs requiring business decisions — with severity definitions, root cause analysis, and highest-leverage verification list.

nodes.name: CROSS_PHASE_REQUIREMENTS_MATRIX.md
nodes.summary: Cross-phase requirements matrix tracing 147 requirements across 16 named sets (SET F through SET N5 plus SET X), mapping each requirement's status, evidence level, and earliest phase promise, with consolidated tally and distribution analysis.

nodes.name: FINDING_ID_RECONCILIATION.md
nodes.summary: Reconciled conflicting finding ID schemes between CROSS_PHASE_AUDIT_REPORT.md, NEXT_PHASE_READINESS_REPORT.md, and CROSS_PHASE_GAP_REGISTER.md, establishing canonical P0-P3/NPD scheme with crosswalks, severity disputes resolved, and citation rules for Phase 1.6 deliverables.

nodes.name: GRAPH_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Graphify structural index report summarizing codebase topology: community hubs, god nodes (most connected files), import cycles, 95 communities with navigation guides, and knowledge gaps from the Louvain community detection analysis.

nodes.name: NEXT_PHASE_READINESS_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.6 readiness assessment across 13 dimensions covering backend completeness, data integrity, security posture, authorization, financial integrity, operational readiness, observability, test confidence, deployment readiness, frontend completeness, and real-hospital readiness — recommending Phase 1.6 scope and gate conditions.

nodes.name: PHASE_0.5_COMPLETION_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 0.5 completion report covering schema consolidation and freeze: new migration function bodies, 9 edge function changes, regenerated artifacts, end-to-end flow verification, test coverage, certification gate results, and compliance notes.

nodes.name: PHASE_1.1_COMPLETION_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.1 completion report covering WhatsApp messaging engine reliability improvements: new migration, new WhatsApp shared modules, 3 edge function changes, regenerated artifacts, end-to-end verification, test coverage, certification gate results, and compliance notes.

nodes.name: PHASE_1.2_COMPLETION_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.2 completion report covering queue runtime and live operations: migration 43 (1131 lines), new queue_runtime shared module, modified endpoints, runtime flow diagram, integration tests, certification gate results, and compliance notes.

nodes.name: PHASE_1.3_COMPLETION_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.3 completion report covering operations and exception management: doctor delay management, dynamic queue intelligence, congestion alerts, operational safety — migration 45 (999 lines), shared modules, edge function changes, and integration tests.

nodes.name: PHASE_1.4_COMPLETION_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.4 completion report covering doctor and clinical operations: doctor session management, clinical queue operations, consultation lifecycle, clinical notes infrastructure, doctor dashboard API, operational safeguards — migration 46 (1026 lines), edge function, and integration tests.

nodes.name: PHASE_1.5_RECOVERY_REPORT.md
nodes.summary: Phase 1.5 recovery report establishing baseline repository state: exact migration/function/test counts, artifact verification, 7 failure diagnoses, independently verified and disproved security findings, gate status on fresh reset, documentation drift, and proposed fix files and migrations.
